title: Spin-orbit-induced gauge field and spin Hall effects in quasi-paraxial fluids of light
summary: We show that quasi-paraxial fluids of light propagating in nonlinear Kerr media naturally experience an effective gauge field arising from the intrinsic spin-orbit interaction of light encoded in Maxwell equations. By deriving the leading nonparaxial corrections to the nonlinear Schrödinger equation governing the fluid evolution, we find that, for circularly polarized beams, these corrections generate an effective Lorentz force that modifies the fluid dynamics.
